name: Piano-crayon
goal: One minimal surface in HTML and in the terminal. Same layout, same colors, same actions. Every visible control does work. No decoration.
out: time range slider / thumb / <input type=range> for playback position
bilingual labels on every chip (FR only on chips; EN in title/aria)
layout: actions: Rejouer | Écouter (labeled chips; Arrêter while on) | clock | La/A readout
tracks: count badge + one color chip per density cluster (Tous = all on)
daw: stacked color waveform lanes (one per live cluster, top-left stack count = cluster count)
lit: current notes as crayon chips + Hz
keyboard: one US ANSI or Canadian French CSA board (picker remaps instantly; 10 fingers; extras only if well clustered)
keyboard: each character key is a crayon note (Z=Do3, D=Do4, Q=La4); the 88-key strip shows the bound glyph
keyboard: compact La0–Do8 (88 keys) under the typing board; computer keys light the matching piano notes

tracks.clickMore: union / stack those clusters; keyboard lights only the selection
tracks.chipLabel: heuristic/FM name or crayon+octave; Hz in the title
tracks.laneColor: pitch-class crayon of the cluster f0
tracks.stackCount: one stacked DAW lane per density cluster (equals live cluster count)

waveform.style: GarageBand stacked lanes, filled mirrored envelope
waveform.oneLanePer: density cluster (Tous = every live cluster stacked)

replay.source: band-limited envelope of the sample (biquad or STFT energy in lo–hi Hz)
replay.seek: drag the lanes; click a column to jump; arrow keys ±1s. Never a range thumb.

live.source: scrolling per-band energy from the analyser

waveform.idle: show the sample lanes if a buffer is loaded, else empty colored beds with names
waveform.clock: m:ss.t / total on replay; Live · m:ss.t while listening

actions.listen: Écouter / Stop — mic FFT, silent analyser (do not tap speakers)
actions.replay: Rejouer / Stop — sample or 8s synth demo; muted until Entendre
actions.keyboard: Pick US or Canadian French CSA; the board remaps at once. Character keys are crayon notes (Z=Do3, D=Do4, Q=La4) and light the matching 88-key. 10 independent fingers, extra keys only if well clustered.
actions.chroma: 12 bars are the color key; height follows energy
actions.autotune: estimate concert A 415–466 Hz; off locks 440

theme.auto: Ambient Light Sensor if permitted; else prefers-color-scheme + hour. Manual swatch sticks until Auto.

spectrum.x: log Hz, A0 27.5 → C8 4186, tick 440 at A4
spectrum.sources: unbounded clustered funds + held keys on the same axes

peakPick.mixPeaks: local maxima, parabolic interp, noise-floor+10 dB, min −78 dBFS, max 512, no semitone pre-dedup
peakPick.cluster: harmonic series collapse (n=2–16, 35¢) then density cluster; keep db > −90; no count cap
peakPick.keys: MIDI score A0–C8, smooth 0.62/0.38, relative gate, chords ≤8

highlights.held: IS PRESSED — user is holding the key; ink outline, no crayon fill
highlights.need: NEEDS TO BE PRESSED — peak-picker target from the current music; crayon fill
highlights.hit: PROPER KEY PRESSED — needed and pressed; crayon fill + bright ring; scores

computerKeys.physical: KeyboardEvent.code / scan-code. Same piano midi on US and Canadian French CSA.
computerKeys.detect: Keyboard Map API / macOS HIToolbox / infer from code+key / fr_CA
computerKeys.map: sequential crayon: KeyZ=Do3, KeyD=Do4, KeyQ=La4 (dual_keyboard.midiForKid / DualNoteMap)

scoring.chart: current peak-picker lit midis from whatever the user is listening to
scoring.hit: 10 + streak; one award per needed-note appearance
scoring.persist: web localStorage crayon-piano-scores; iOS UserDefaults; TUI ~/.crayon_piano_scores.json
scoring.keys: score, allTime, bestBySource (live / demo / wav name)
